sentences.en: The soldier refused to fire his rifle at the enemy.
sentences.zh: 这名军人拒绝向敌人开枪。

sentences.en: The soldier was wounded in the leg and couldn't move.
sentences.zh: 这名军人腿部受伤，无法移动。

sentences.en: The soldier carried on as if his wound was nothing.
sentences.zh: 这名军人仿佛伤口微不足道，继续前行。

senses.zh: 军人；兵蚁；懒汉；[口]一片烤面包
[口]磨洋工；当兵；坚持干；假称害病
